semantic_findings: The current low-inventory mother rule is broad: inside-gap and surrounding-corridor density need only be no higher than the local per-price-width average.
The complete chart book still contains visibly acute rise/fall cliffs, recently formed shock structures, and corridors that are not the very clean low-chip fracture requested by the human.
The frozen fixed long-decline plus no-near-touch lane is not profitable, so those two conditions alone do not translate the visual hypothesis into an executable edge.
The walk-forward selector uses no admission gate in 2017-2018 and a deep-but-not-acute two-condition gate in 2019-2020; this is not a stable single rule across all years.
Narrow gap is not a deployable condition by itself because an executable entry must retain enough net distance to U after 40 bp round-trip costs.
scientific_interpretation: Visual inspection supports another outcome-blind semantic repair of clean corridor occupancy before any new profit optimization. It does not upgrade the marginal Development result into a strategy.
